        var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        var maxW = 400;
        var maxH = 600;
        var w = img.width;
        var h = img.height;
        if (w > maxW) {
          h = h * maxW / w;
          w = maxW;
        }
        if (h > maxH) {
          w = w * maxH / h;
          h = maxH;
        }
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
        var dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7);
        var targetImg = document.getElementById(imgId);
        if (targetImg) {

    };

  }

    lbImgkm.src = ''
  }
